label: A3B2CD8_cP56_212_d_c_a_ce-001
title: Li$_{2}$NiGe$_{3}$O$_{5}$ Structure
comments:
This is an ordered quaternary form of the spinel-like \href{current_web_home_dir/A5BC8_cP56_212_cd_a_ce-001}{LiFe$_{5}$O$_{8}$ structure}. 
 Space group $P4_{3}32$ \#212 is a \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/ChiralSpaceGroups/}{Sohncke Class II chiral space group}, so this structure may also be found in the enantiomorphic space group $P4_{1}32$ \#213.
